deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: refactor first, then the test commit. Cases 1-6 are red until the table lands, so the suite rides in a test commit AFTER the fix, as the brief allows. Red-before was measured by running the new suite against 7e47fbd sources in a temp copy (git archive, node_modules junctioned): 6 red, guard 7 green. The in-tree run was blocked at that moment by a sibling's half-written desk/src/lib/rules/maths.ts. (2) Case 4 is a new test (turn case 4) over the old SWEEP plus the nine turn states plus paused+pending. The old view case 5 sweep is left as it was, because case 8 says view cases 1-8 stay unchanged. (3) Case 8 GUARD adds no test of its own: it is the existing view/ladder cases and uat-surface-test, green unchanged. (4) The Playwright TV capture was NOT run; a server-side render stands in for it. The TV row changed in exactly one state: a paused scene with a reply pending. It used to draw Resume (disabled) and Finish (disabled), a dead end. It now draws Cancel & go back and Pause & coach (disabled), the waiting row. A live server cannot reach that state after this change: pause is refused while pending, and store.ts load() sets pending:null on every reload. So I diffed react-dom/server renders of 7e47fbd against the tree: 11 states x {plain, menu} = 22 renders. The TV text differs only in that state. The phone differs in paused+pending (Resume now disabled) and in unprepared (Help me answer and Choose a phrase now disabled). (5) Refusal-status change: choice outside the quiz and coach before any learner reply were 400 and are now 409, because case 5 needs 409 exactly where the table refuses. The option-range check (400) and the stale-question lastTurnId check (409) are kept as data guards.
notes: TURN TABLE API (desk/src/lib/english/turn.ts, pure, safe from the TV): TURN_STATES / TurnState = finished | preparing | waiting | unprepared | moment | paused | coaching | quiz | your-turn. turnState(c) decides them in that order: finished first; then pending (waiting if there are turns, else preparing); no turns = unprepared; moment wins over paused; then paused, coaching (phase), quiz (quizOpen), your-turn. TURN_ACTIONS / TurnAction = turn, cue, quiz, choice, coach, replay, capture (= START the mic), pause, resume, repeat, leave, finish, moment-done; isTurnAction(a). ACCEPTS: Record<TurnState, TurnAction[]>: finished [repeat]; preparing and waiting [leave, repeat]; unprepared [resume, finish, leave, repeat]; moment [moment-done, resume, finish, leave, repeat]; paused [resume, pause (a toggle), finish, leave, repeat]; coaching [replay, pause, resume, finish, leave, repeat]; quiz [turn, cue, quiz, choice, coach, capture, pause, resume, finish, leave, repeat]; your-turn = the quiz list without choice. accepts(c, action) = the table plus the one data guard (coach needs a learner reply). refusal(c, action) = the learner sentence (per state; in quiz/your-turn a per-action line for coach, replay, choice, moment-done). SERVER: englishCommand, after the episode/commandId/audience checks, does this. capture with active!==true is always accepted: it stops the mic. Then !isTurnAction -> 400 'Unknown conversation action.' Then !accepts -> 409 refusal(). Then the per-action handlers run. The data guards that stay: the 24-reply cap (400), the stale lastTurnId (409), reply text and mode (400), choice option 0/1 (400), replay needing c.coaching (400). VIEW: every conversation command lingaView offers carries disabled: !accepts(c, action). Quiz, coach and the phone's cue/quiz are also disabled on `waiting`, which includes input.busy. Inside lingaView the local helpers are st (the turn state), inFlight (preparing or waiting) and refused(action). FOR LINGA B (wave 3): a new turn feature adds its action to TURN_ACTIONS and ACCEPTS. It does NOT add a guard in englishCommand. Tools/linga-rules-test.cjs turn case 5 walks 9 states x every action in its own CONVERSATION_ACTIONS list, so add a new action there too, plus a TURN_STATES fixture if you add a state. Offering review/reuse on the recap or the talk screen: give the action disabled: refused(<action>) and turn case 4 checks it against the server. The phone's live panel still picks its branch by c.paused first (so paused+pending draws Resume, disabled), then st==='coaching'. KNOWN GAP, not fixed (outside the write set): uat/driver/surface.cjs counts a view action as 'unrendered' when both it and its rendered control are disabled. Pending states already did this (quiz/coach). It now also covers unprepared (cue/quiz) and waiting (phone finish, menu finish). This is coverage noise in LT runs only; the fix is to tie disabled controls to disabled view actions in surface.cjs. VIEW_ACTION_IDS still has no 'pause'. Space is a TV key the view does not offer; adding it would need a rendered control for uat-surface case 4. Flag reads (the premise grep) in view/conversation/LingaPhone/LingaTV/store: 75 -> 37, plus 6 in turn.ts.
